summary: An unobtainable +1 flail that can apply Madness for 1 turn on a failed DC 13 Wisdom save.

fields.Madness: The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom save against Madness for 1 turn. Affected creatures become hostile to others nearby. The pinned source reports the listed Psychic damage and Paralysed outcomes are not implemented.
fields.Tenacity: In the main hand, a missed melee attack can spend a Reaction to deal Bludgeoning damage equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
